summary: Executed backend + frontend testing for inventory, misc creditors, journal filters, and analytical pages on public URL. Core flows passed, with one UI requirement gap and one API consistency observation.

minor.issue: When non_zero_only=false (default API call), account code 1250 (ودائع لأجل) is still returned as zero-balance row; UI normal flow hides it via non_zero_only=true. This is a consistency gap versus expected hidden normal view behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdowns exist and function, but explicit visible labels 'صنف القيد' and 'نوع القيد' are missing from UI text.

action_items: Add explicit visible labels for journal filters: 'صنف القيد' and 'نوع القيد' to match requirement wording.
Decide and standardize trial-balance behavior for account 1250 on raw API default response vs normal UI flow (non_zero_only=true).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk across accounting modules.
Inventory and misc-creditor movement handlers correctly exclude Mongo _id in API responses via hydrate_* helpers.
Journal filtering logic correctly maps entry_category inventory->inventory and misc_creditors->misc_creditor, and returns approved entries only in tested paths.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-ITER72-* inventory items/movements and misc-creditor movements; cleaned automatically in pytest teardown via Mongo delete filters by TEST prefix and organization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest passed 8/8 on public URL (inventory in/out, reject over-issue, misc obligation/payment with bank guard and overpayment guard, journal category/item filters, trial-balance asset/liability checks, data-flow validation true). Playwright verified module cards/routes, JournalEntries columns + filters, no edit/delete in list table, feasibility/actuarial calculations update and do not create journal entries, and trial balance UI hides 1250 in normal view. ETA Electronic Invoice integration is MOCKED and out of this scope.
rca of the issue: UI label gap RCA: JournalEntriesPage renders the two filter selects without explicit label text nodes ('صنف القيد'/'نوع القيد'), so requirement phrasing is not fully met despite working functionality. Trial-balance consistency RCA: backend API includes zeroed term-deposit row when non_zero_only=false; UI calls API with non_zero_only=true by default, so users do not see it in normal flow.
